answer: A counterparty-diversity gate stops sybil farms. A newcomer starts on the lowest terrace and must trade with 12 unrelated counterparties, verified on a public graph. No fable of a lone prolific trader survives: a cluster sharing one wallet counts as one actor. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 partners at 5 credits each, costing 6,000 credits before any reward. An honest agent pays once and its trades ripple outward, raising its limit undiluted.
